capability_labels.AX005-SA004-V001: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer, state the outbound call context, and ask for a verification factor.
steps.expected_behavior: Initiate the call by stating the outbound call context and requesting a non-sensitive verification factor.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मी marketplace मधून बोलत आहे. तुमच्या एका order बद्दल call केला आहे. Verify करण्यासाठी तुमचा registered pincode सांगू शकता का?
steps.planner_rationale: As an outbound call, I must first verify the identity of the person answering before disclosing detailed order status.

steps.purpose: Provide the requested verification factor while expressing time pressure.
steps.text: हो, pincode 411038 आहे. लवकर सांगा, काय problem आहे? मी थोडा घाईत आहे.
steps.clean_text: हो, pincode 411038 आहे. लवकर सांगा, काय problem आहे? मी थोडा घाईत आहे.
steps.model_visible_text: हो, pincode 411038 आहे. लवकर सांगा, काय problem आहे? मी थोडा घाईत आहे.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided pincode.
steps.expected_behavior: Call the verify_customer_identity tool with the pincode factor.
steps.planner_rationale: The user provided a pincode, so I need to verify it before proceeding.

steps.purpose: Inform the user of the verification failure and ask for an alternative factor.
steps.expected_behavior: Politely inform the user that the verification failed and request a different knowledge factor.
steps.text: माफ करा, हा pincode match होत नाहीये. तुम्ही तुमची date of birth सांगू शकता का?
steps.planner_rationale: The pincode was incorrect, so I must ask for another valid factor like date of birth to complete verification.

steps.text: Oh sorry. जुना pincode सांगितला. Date of birth 14 August आहे. पुढे बोला.
steps.clean_text: Oh sorry. जुना pincode सांगितला. Date of birth 14 August आहे. पुढे बोला.
steps.model_visible_text: Oh sorry. जुना pincode सांगितला. Date of birth 14 August आहे. पुडे बोला.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the newly provided date of birth.
steps.expected_behavior: Call the verify_customer_identity tool with the date of birth factor.
steps.planner_rationale: The user provided their date of birth, which I will now use to verify their identity.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the current status of the order.
steps.expected_behavior: Look up the order details now that identity is verified.
steps.planner_rationale: Identity is verified, so I can now check the order's fulfilment status to understand the context of the delay.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the courier tracking details to find the specific delivery exception.
steps.expected_behavior: Check the shipment tracking to find out exactly why the order is stuck.
steps.planner_rationale: The order is shipped but delayed beyond the promised date, so I need to check the courier scans for exceptions.

steps.purpose: Explain the delivery exception to the user.
steps.expected_behavior: State the current status and the exact exception returned by the tracking tool without making unverified promises.
steps.text: तुमची order shipped झाली आहे, पण courier ला तुमचा address सापडत नाहीये. त्यामुळे delivery ला delay होत आहे.
steps.planner_rationale: I must inform the user that the order is shipped but delayed because the courier cannot reach their address, grounding my response strictly in the tool results.

steps.purpose: Express frustration about the delay and ask to raise a complaint quickly.
steps.text: अरे यार! मी meeting मध्ये आहे, मला जास्त वेळ नाहीये. तुम्ही delay ची complaint raise करा.
steps.clean_text: अरे यार! मी meeting मध्ये आहे, मला जास्त वेळ नाहीये. तुम्ही delay ची complaint raise करा.
steps.model_visible_text: अरे यार! मी meeting मध्ये आहे, मला जास्त वेळ नाहीये. तुम्ही delay ची complaint raise करा.

steps.purpose: Raise a delivery complaint for the delayed order.
steps.expected_behavior: Call the raise_delivery_complaint tool with the reason 'delayed'.
steps.planner_rationale: The user explicitly requested to raise a complaint for the delay, and the order is past its promised window, making this action valid.

steps.purpose: Return complaint ID and resolution timeline
Provide the complaint ID and resolution timeline to the user.
steps.expected_behavior: Share the complaint ID and resolution days exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: मी delay ची complaint raise केली आहे. तुमचा complaint ID CMP-5544 आहे आणि 2 दिवसात resolution मिळेल.
steps.planner_rationale: I need to confirm the complaint has been raised and provide the exact ID and timeframe from the tool result to ground my response.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the resolution and end the conversation.

ir.terminal_condition: Complaint raised with an id and the resolution window stated.
